content.comment_body: Hello, I have two questions: Do the trend graphics only function through a Cloud server? Also, I noticed that the hold mode button isn't working for a local project using the basis module. Has anyone encountered this issue before? Thanks in advance. [user_name]
Could you clarify which "hold mode button" you are referring to?
Apologies, I located the configuration for the hold button. [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked whether trend graphics in the [product_name] web editor require connectivity to a Cloud server and reported issues with the hold mode button during local project execution. The user later resolved the button issue but still awaits clarification about the possible Cloud requirement for trend graphics, indicating uncertainty about offline usability of visualization functions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes that trend graphics will operate without needing a Cloud server and expects dependable local control through mode buttons in the [product_name] web editor.
